title: 伊拉斯謨大橋
summary: 鹿特丹的伊拉斯謨大橋全長 802 m，以 139 m 高、彎折不對稱的鋼塔支承約 284 m 的斜張主跨，南端另有 89 m 的開合橋；橋面寬 33.8 m，由兩根箱形主梁與每 4.9 m 一道的橫梁組成，承載車道、電車軌道與人行自行車道。本課從背索如何降低塔的彎矩、橋面橫向受力、鋼塔焊接、開合橋配重與電車軌伸縮，到 1996 年通車後的雨風振動觀測、調諧液壓阻尼器、塗裝與開合機械的長期維護。
summaryEn: Rotterdam’s Erasmus Bridge is 802 m long; a bent, asymmetric 139 m steel pylon carries a cable-stayed main span of about 284 m, and an 89 m bascule sits at the south end. The 33.8 m deck, two box spines with cross beams every 4.9 m, carries traffic lanes, tram tracks, footpaths and cycle tracks. The course runs from how back stays cut pylon bending, transverse deck action, pylon welding, bascule counterweighting and tram-rail expansion, to observation of rain–wind vibration after the 1996 opening, tuned hydraulic dampers and long-term care of coatings and bascule machinery.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩」與「雙主梁、橫梁與電車荷載的橋面」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "How back stays cut bending in an asymmetric pylon" and "Twin spines, cross beams and tram loads": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: How back stays cut bending in an asymmetric pylon: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「139 m 彎折鋼塔」如何影響伊拉斯謨大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “139 m bent steel pylon” governs force, deformation or durability in “Erasmus Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伊拉斯謨大橋的最初構想受阿拉米略橋啟發，是一座約 150 m 高、沒有背索、以塔身自重與傾斜平衡主跨的混凝土塔。工程可行性檢討後改為 139 m 的鋼塔並加上背索，原因是城市橋梁的活載變化很大：60 t 級卡車與電車只停在主跨某處時，若沒有背索，主跨斜索拉力的變化全部要由塔身彎曲承受，塔底彎矩隨交通劇烈起伏。背索把塔頂連到岸側錨固點，活載造成的水平力增量大部分由背索的軸力平衡，塔主要承受壓力，彎矩與疲勞應力幅都大幅降低。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「139 m 彎折鋼塔」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Erasmus Bridge concept, inspired by the Alamillo Bridge, began as a concrete pylon about 150 m tall with no back stays, balancing the main span by its own weight and lean. After engineering review it became a 139 m steel pylon with back stays, because urban live load varies greatly: when 60 t trucks or trams stop somewhere on the main span without back stays, the entire change in main-span stay force must be resisted by pylon bending, so the base moment swings sharply with traffic. Back stays tie the pylon head to anchorage on the shore side, balancing most of the live-load horizontal increment by axial force, so the pylon works mainly in compression with much lower bending and fatigue stress ranges. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “139 m bent steel pylon” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：主跨活載 w = 30 kN/m × 284 m = 8,520 kN，合力距塔 142 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Main-span live load w = 30 kN/m × 284 m = 8,520 kN acts with its resultant 142 m from the pylon.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要塔身向後傾斜得夠多，就不需要背索也能承受任何活載。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the pylon leans back far enough, it can take any live load without back stays." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「139 m 彎折鋼塔」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “139 m bent steel pylon”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩
knowledge.titleEn: How back stays cut bending in an asymmetric pylon
knowledge.text: 伊拉斯謨大橋的最初構想受阿拉米略橋啟發，是一座約 150 m 高、沒有背索、以塔身自重與傾斜平衡主跨的混凝土塔。工程可行性檢討後改為 139 m 的鋼塔並加上背索，原因是城市橋梁的活載變化很大：60 t 級卡車與電車只停在主跨某處時，若沒有背索，主跨斜索拉力的變化全部要由塔身彎曲承受，塔底彎矩隨交通劇烈起伏。
knowledge.textEn: The Erasmus Bridge concept, inspired by the Alamillo Bridge, began as a concrete pylon about 150 m tall with no back stays, balancing the main span by its own weight and lean. After engineering review it became a 139 m steel pylon with back stays, because urban live load varies greatly: when 60 t trucks or trams stop somewhere on the main span without back stays, the entire change in main-span stay force must be resisted by pylon bending, so the base moment swings sharply with traffic.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要塔身向後傾斜得夠多，就不需要背索也能承受任何活載。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the pylon leans back far enough, it can take any live load without back stays. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「伊拉斯謨大橋」的「背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩：機制與傳力路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出載重來源、構件、接點與支承的傳力邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「跨河橋梁試載日」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與幾何版本、支承條件、荷載方向與獨立位移紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “How back stays cut bending in an asymmetric pylon: mechanism and load path” in “Erasmus Bridge”. Draw the load, member, connection and support load paths; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Bridge proof-test day” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for geometry revision, supports, load direction and independent displacement records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "How back stays cut bending in an asymmetric pylon" is correct?
options: 只要塔身向後傾斜得夠多，就不需要背索也能承受任何活載。
伊拉斯謨大橋的最初構想受阿拉米略橋啟發，是一座約 150 m 高、沒有背索、以塔身自重與傾斜平衡主跨的混凝土塔。
人行道懸臂荷載小，所以橫梁根部不需要特別檢查。
optionsEn: If the pylon leans back far enough, it can take any live load without back stays.
The Erasmus Bridge concept, inspired by the Alamillo Bridge, began as a concrete pylon about 150 m tall with no back stays, balancing the main span by its own weight and lean.
Footpath cantilevers carry little load, so cross-beam roots need no special attention.
quiz.explanation: 伊拉斯謨大橋的最初構想受阿拉米略橋啟發，是一座約 150 m 高、沒有背索、以塔身自重與傾斜平衡主跨的混凝土塔。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Erasmus Bridge concept, inspired by the Alamillo Bridge, began as a concrete pylon about 150 m tall with no back stays, balancing the main span by its own weight and lean. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: How back stays cut bending in an asymmetric pylon: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「139 m 彎折鋼塔」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “139 m bent steel pylon” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：主跨活載 w = 30 kN/m × 284 m = 8,520 kN，合力距塔 142 m。無背索時塔底附加彎矩 M = 8,520×142 ≈ 1,209,800 kN·m（等於塔頂水平力 8,520×142/125 ≈ 9,680 kN 乘以塔高 125 m）；若背索平衡 75% 的水平增量，M 降為約 302,500 kN·m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Main-span live load w = 30 kN/m × 284 m = 8,520 kN acts with its resultant 142 m from the pylon. Without back stays the extra pylon-base moment is M = 8,520×142 ≈ 1,209,800 kN·m (the head force 8,520×142/125 ≈ 9,680 kN times a 125 m pylon height); if back stays balance 75% of the horizontal increment, M falls to about 302,500 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以全橋模型比較有無背索、不同背索勁度下的塔底彎矩包絡與疲勞應力幅；成橋後以載重試驗在主跨不同位置停放車輛，量測塔頂位移、背索力增量與塔底應變，與模型比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare pylon-base moment envelopes and fatigue stress ranges with and without back stays and for different back-stay stiffness in a global model; after completion park vehicles at several main-span positions in a load test and compare measured pylon-head displacement, back-stay force increments and base strains with the model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 主跨活載 w = 30 kN/m × 284 m = 8,520 kN，合力距塔 142 m。無背索時塔底附加彎矩 M = 8,520×142 ≈ 1,209,800 kN·m（等於塔頂水平力 8,520×142/125 ≈ 9,680 kN 乘以塔高 125 m）；若背索平衡 75% 的水平增量，M 降為約 302,500 kN·m。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Main-span live load w = 30 kN/m × 284 m = 8,520 kN acts with its resultant 142 m from the pylon. Without back stays the extra pylon-base moment is M = 8,520×142 ≈ 1,209,800 kN·m (the head force 8,520×142/125 ≈ 9,680 kN times a 125 m pylon height); if back stays balance 75% of the horizontal increment, M falls to about 302,500 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "How back stays cut bending in an asymmetric pylon", which statement holds?
options: 開合橋的配重一次設定好就永遠不用調整。
電車軌道可以像路面一樣直接跨過伸縮縫，不需要特別裝置。
主跨活載 w = 30 kN/m × 284 m = 8,520 kN，合力距塔 142 m。
optionsEn: A bascule’s counterweight is set once and never needs adjusting.
Tram rails can cross an expansion joint like the road surface without special devices.
Main-span live load w = 30 kN/m × 284 m = 8,520 kN acts with its resultant 142 m from the pylon.
quiz.explanation: 主跨活載 w = 30 kN/m × 284 m = 8,520 kN，合力距塔 142 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Main-span live load w = 30 kN/m × 284 m = 8,520 kN acts with its resultant 142 m from the pylon. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: How back stays cut bending in an asymmetric pylon: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「139 m 彎折鋼塔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “139 m bent steel pylon” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以全橋模型比較有無背索、不同背索勁度下的塔底彎矩包絡與疲勞應力幅；成橋後以載重試驗在主跨不同位置停放車輛，量測塔頂位移、背索力增量與塔底應變，與模型比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pylon-base moment envelopes and fatigue stress ranges with and without back stays and for different back-stay stiffness in a global model; after completion park vehicles at several main-span positions in a load test and compare measured pylon-head displacement, back-stay force increments and base strains with the model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以造型為主的橋梁在概念階段就要做活載與疲勞的初步檢核，並把結構需求（例如背索）回饋給建築師；造型變更須由結構設計者重新簽認塔與錨固的計算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: An architecture-led bridge needs preliminary live-load and fatigue checks at concept stage, feeding structural needs such as back stays back to the architect; any change of form requires the structural designer to re-sign pylon and anchorage calculations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若背索勁度不足或錨固點沉陷，塔在交通荷載下的擺動與彎矩增大，塔身焊道承受較大的疲勞應力幅；背索若鬆弛，主跨在重車通過時下撓加大，行車與電車舒適度變差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Soft back stays or a settling anchorage increase pylon sway and bending under traffic and raise fatigue stress ranges in pylon welds; slack back stays let the main span deflect more under heavy vehicles, degrading ride and tram comfort. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以全橋模型比較有無背索、不同背索勁度下的塔底彎矩包絡與疲勞應力幅；成橋後以載重試驗在主跨不同位置停放車輛，量測塔頂位移、背索力增量與塔底應變，與模型比較。
knowledge.textEn: Compare pylon-base moment envelopes and fatigue stress ranges with and without back stays and for different back-stay stiffness in a global model; after completion park vehicles at several main-span positions in a load test and compare measured pylon-head displacement, back-stay force increments and base strains with the model.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以造型為主的橋梁在概念階段就要做活載與疲勞的初步檢核，並把結構需求（例如背索）回饋給建築師；造型變更須由結構設計者重新簽認塔與錨固的計算。
knowledge.textEn: An architecture-led bridge needs preliminary live-load and fatigue checks at concept stage, feeding structural needs such as back stays back to the architect; any change of form requires the structural designer to re-sign pylon and anchorage calculations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "How back stays cut bending in an asymmetric pylon"?
options: 以全橋模型比較有無背索、不同背索勁度下的塔底彎矩包絡與疲勞應力幅；成橋後以載重試驗在主跨不同位置停放車輛，量測塔頂位移、背索力增量與塔底應變，與模型比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
阻尼器的阻尼係數越大，斜索的減振效果就越好。
optionsEn: Compare pylon-base moment envelopes and fatigue stress ranges with and without back stays and for different back-stay stiffness in a global model.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The larger the damper coefficient, the better the stay is damped.
quiz.explanation: 以全橋模型比較有無背索、不同背索勁度下的塔底彎矩包絡與疲勞應力幅；成橋後以載重試驗在主跨不同位置停放車輛，量測塔頂位移、背索力增量與塔底應變，與模型比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare pylon-base moment envelopes and fatigue stress ranges with and without back stays and for different back-stay stiffness in a global model; after completion park vehicles at several main-span positions in a load test and compare measured pylon-head displacement, back-stay force increments and base strains with the model. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: How back stays cut bending in an asymmetric pylon: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「139 m 彎折鋼塔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “139 m bent steel pylon” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若背索勁度不足或錨固點沉陷，塔在交通荷載下的擺動與彎矩增大，塔身焊道承受較大的疲勞應力幅；背索若鬆弛，主跨在重車通過時下撓加大，行車與電車舒適度變差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Soft back stays or a settling anchorage increase pylon sway and bending under traffic and raise fatigue stress ranges in pylon welds; slack back stays let the main span deflect more under heavy vehicles, degrading ride and tram comfort. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：背索把塔頂連到岸側錨固點，活載造成的水平力增量大部分由背索的軸力平衡，塔主要承受壓力，彎矩與疲勞應力幅都大幅降低。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Back stays tie the pylon head to anchorage on the shore side, balancing most of the live-load horizontal increment by axial force, so the pylon works mainly in compression with much lower bending and fatigue stress ranges.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要塔身向後傾斜得夠多，就不需要背索也能承受任何活載。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the pylon leans back far enough, it can take any live load without back stays." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Soft back stays or a settling anchorage increase pylon sway and bending under traffic and raise fatigue stress ranges in pylon welds; slack back stays let the main span deflect more under heavy vehicles, degrading ride and tram comfort.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "How back stays cut bending in an asymmetric pylon" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若背索勁度不足或錨固點沉陷，塔在交通荷載下的擺動與彎矩增大，塔身焊道承受較大的疲勞應力幅；背索若鬆弛，主跨在重車通過時下撓加大，行車與電車舒適度變差。
人行道懸臂荷載小，所以橫梁根部不需要特別檢查。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Soft back stays or a settling anchorage increase pylon sway and bending under traffic and raise fatigue stress ranges in pylon welds.
Footpath cantilevers carry little load, so cross-beam roots need no special attention.

quiz.explanationEn: Soft back stays or a settling anchorage increase pylon sway and bending under traffic and raise fatigue stress ranges in pylon welds; slack back stays let the main span deflect more under heavy vehicles, degrading ride and tram comfort. steps.title: 雙主梁、橫梁與電車荷載的橋面：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Twin spines, cross beams and tram loads: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「4.9 m 間距橫梁」如何影響伊拉斯謨大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cross beams at 4.9 m” governs force, deformation or durability in “Erasmus Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伊拉斯謨大橋的橋面寬 33.8 m，由兩根高 2.25 m、寬 1.25 m 的箱形主梁承擔縱向彎曲與斜索錨固，四線車道與兩條電車軌道位於兩根主梁之間；橫梁每 4.9 m 一道，並向兩側各懸出 6.7 m 支承人行道與自行車道。電車軌道把集中輪載固定在同一位置反覆通過，對軌道下方的橫梁與主梁連接造成高循環疲勞；懸臂部分雖然荷載較小，但彎矩隨懸出長度平方增加，橫梁根部是應力集中的位置。橫梁也把兩根主梁連成整體，提供抗扭能力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「4.9 m 間距橫梁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Erasmus deck is 33.8 m wide, with two box spines 2.25 m deep and 1.25 m wide carrying longitudinal bending and the stay anchorages; four traffic lanes and two tram tracks sit between the spines, and cross beams every 4.9 m cantilever 6.7 m each side to carry footpaths and cycle tracks. Tram tracks put concentrated wheel loads repeatedly on the same line, causing high-cycle fatigue at cross-beam-to-spine connections beneath the rails; the cantilevers carry lighter loads, but moment grows with the square of the overhang, concentrating stress at the cross-beam roots. The cross beams also tie the two spines together for torsional resistance. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cross beams at 4.9 m” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：橫梁分擔寬 4.9 m、面荷載 12 kPa（含電車與鋪面）時 w = 58.8 kN/m，主梁間跨距 20 m 的簡支彎矩 M = wL²/8 = 58.8×20²/8 = 2,940 kN·m；懸臂 6.7 m、面荷載 11 kPa 時 w = 53.9 kN/m，根部 M = wL²/2 ≈ 53.9×6.7²/2 ≈ 1,210 kN·m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A cross beam with 4.9 m tributary width and 12 kPa including trams and surfacing carries w = 58.8 kN/m; over a 20 m span between spines the simply supported moment is M = wL²/8 = 58.8×20²/8 = 2,940 kN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「人行道懸臂荷載小，所以橫梁根部不需要特別檢查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Footpath cantilevers carry little load, so cross-beam roots need no special attention." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「4.9 m 間距橫梁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Cross beams at 4.9 m”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：人行道懸臂荷載小，所以橫梁根部不需要特別檢查。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「雙主梁、橫梁與電車荷載的橋面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 雙主梁、橫梁與電車荷載的橋面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Twin spines, cross beams and tram loads: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「4.9 m 間距橫梁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cross beams at 4.9 m” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：橫梁分擔寬 4.9 m、面荷載 12 kPa（含電車與鋪面）時 w = 58.8 kN/m，主梁間跨距 20 m 的簡支彎矩 M = wL²/8 = 58.8×20²/8 = 2,940 kN·m；懸臂 6.7 m、面荷載 11 kPa 時 w = 53.9 kN/m，根部 M = wL²/2 ≈ 53.9×6.7²/2 ≈ 1,210 kN·m。荷載與跨距為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A cross beam with 4.9 m tributary width and 12 kPa including trams and surfacing carries w = 58.8 kN/m; over a 20 m span between spines the simply supported moment is M = wL²/8 = 58.8×20²/8 = 2,940 kN·m. A 6.7 m cantilever at 11 kPa carries w = 53.9 kN/m with a root moment M = wL²/2 ≈ 53.9×6.7²/2 ≈ 1,210 kN·m. Loads and span are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以局部有限元素模型分析電車軌下方橫梁與主梁接頭的熱點應力，依疲勞細節分類與電車通過次數評估壽命；施工時檢驗橫梁接頭焊道的超音波與磁粒檢測，營運期定期檢查軌道下方的焊趾。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Analyse hot-spot stresses at cross-beam-to-spine joints under the tram rails with local finite-element models and assess life from detail categories and tram passages; inspect cross-beam joint welds by ultrasonic and magnetic-particle testing during construction, and check weld toes under the rails periodically in service.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 橫梁分擔寬 4.9 m、面荷載 12 kPa（含電車與鋪面）時 w = 58.8 kN/m，主梁間跨距 20 m 的簡支彎矩 M = wL²/8 = 58.8×20²/8 = 2,940 kN·m；懸臂 6.7 m、面荷載 11 kPa 時 w = 53.9 kN/m，根部 M = wL²/2 ≈ 53.9×6.7²/2 ≈ 1,210 kN·m。荷載與跨距為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A cross beam with 4.9 m tributary width and 12 kPa including trams and surfacing carries w = 58.8 kN/m; over a 20 m span between spines the simply supported moment is M = wL²/8 = 58.8×20²/8 = 2,940 kN·m. A 6.7 m cantilever at 11 kPa carries w = 53.9 kN/m with a root moment M = wL²/2 ≈ 53.9×6.7²/2 ≈ 1,210 kN·m. Loads and span are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「雙主梁、橫梁與電車荷載的橋面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Twin spines, cross beams and tram loads", which statement holds?
options: 橫梁分擔寬 4.9 m、面荷載 12 kPa（含電車與鋪面）時 w = 58.8 kN/m，主梁間跨距 20 m 的簡支彎矩 M = wL²/8 = 58.8×20²/8 = 2,940 kN·m。
斜索只要最後一次全部張拉到設計索力，順序並不重要。
斜索振動只會在颱風等級的強風中發生。
optionsEn: A cross beam with 4.9 m tributary width and 12 kPa including trams and surfacing carries w = 58.8 kN/m.
As long as all stays reach design force at the end, the stressing order does not matter.
Stay vibration only happens in typhoon-strength winds.
quiz.explanation: 橫梁分擔寬 4.9 m、面荷載 12 kPa（含電車與鋪面）時 w = 58.8 kN/m，主梁間跨距 20 m 的簡支彎矩 M = wL²/8 = 58.8×20²/8 = 2,940 kN·m；懸臂 6.7 m、面荷載 11 kPa 時 w = 53.9 kN/m，根部 M = wL²/2 ≈ 53.9×6.7²/2 ≈ 1,210 kN·m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A cross beam with 4.9 m tributary width and 12 kPa including trams and surfacing carries w = 58.8 kN/m; over a 20 m span between spines the simply supported moment is M = wL²/8 = 58.8×20²/8 = 2,940 kN·m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 雙主梁、橫梁與電車荷載的橋面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Twin spines, cross beams and tram loads: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「4.9 m 間距橫梁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cross beams at 4.9 m” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以局部有限元素模型分析電車軌下方橫梁與主梁接頭的熱點應力，依疲勞細節分類與電車通過次數評估壽命；施工時檢驗橫梁接頭焊道的超音波與磁粒檢測，營運期定期檢查軌道下方的焊趾。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Analyse hot-spot stresses at cross-beam-to-spine joints under the tram rails with local finite-element models and assess life from detail categories and tram passages; inspect cross-beam joint welds by ultrasonic and magnetic-particle testing during construction, and check weld toes under the rails periodically in service. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：電車軌道與橋面結構的介面（軌道扣件、減振墊、排水）要由軌道與結構工程師共同設計，並在維護手冊中把軌道下方接頭列為優先疲勞檢查區。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The interface between tram track and deck (fastenings, resilient pads, drainage) should be designed jointly by track and structural engineers, and the maintenance manual should list joints beneath the rails as priority fatigue inspection areas.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：電車軌下方的橫梁接頭若細部設計不當或焊接缺陷，反覆輪載可能引發疲勞裂縫並沿腹板擴展；軌道支承鬆動則使衝擊放大，加速裂縫成長與噪音。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Poor detailing or weld defects at cross-beam joints beneath the tram rails let repeated wheel loads start fatigue cracks that spread along the web; loose rail fastenings amplify impact, accelerating crack growth and noise. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以局部有限元素模型分析電車軌下方橫梁與主梁接頭的熱點應力，依疲勞細節分類與電車通過次數評估壽命；施工時檢驗橫梁接頭焊道的超音波與磁粒檢測，營運期定期檢查軌道下方的焊趾。
knowledge.textEn: Analyse hot-spot stresses at cross-beam-to-spine joints under the tram rails with local finite-element models and assess life from detail categories and tram passages; inspect cross-beam joint welds by ultrasonic and magnetic-particle testing during construction, and check weld toes under the rails periodically in service.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 電車軌道與橋面結構的介面（軌道扣件、減振墊、排水）要由軌道與結構工程師共同設計，並在維護手冊中把軌道下方接頭列為優先疲勞檢查區。
knowledge.textEn: The interface between tram track and deck (fastenings, resilient pads, drainage) should be designed jointly by track and structural engineers, and the maintenance manual should list joints beneath the rails as priority fatigue inspection areas.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雙主梁、橫梁與電車荷載的橋面」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Twin spines, cross beams and tram loads"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以局部有限元素模型分析電車軌下方橫梁與主梁接頭的熱點應力，依疲勞細節分類與電車通過次數評估壽命。
鋼橋重新油漆主要是為了好看，對結構壽命影響不大。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Analyse hot-spot stresses at cross-beam-to-spine joints under the tram rails with local finite-element models and assess life from detail categories and tram passages.
Repainting a steel bridge is mainly cosmetic and hardly affects structural life.
quiz.explanation: 以局部有限元素模型分析電車軌下方橫梁與主梁接頭的熱點應力，依疲勞細節分類與電車通過次數評估壽命；施工時檢驗橫梁接頭焊道的超音波與磁粒檢測，營運期定期檢查軌道下方的焊趾。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Analyse hot-spot stresses at cross-beam-to-spine joints under the tram rails with local finite-element models and assess life from detail categories and tram passages; inspect cross-beam joint welds by ultrasonic and magnetic-particle testing during construction, and check weld toes under the rails periodically in service. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 雙主梁、橫梁與電車荷載的橋面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Twin spines, cross beams and tram loads: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「4.9 m 間距橫梁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cross beams at 4.9 m” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 電車軌下方的橫梁接頭若細部設計不當或焊接缺陷，反覆輪載可能引發疲勞裂縫並沿腹板擴展；軌道支承鬆動則使衝擊放大，加速裂縫成長與噪音。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Poor detailing or weld defects at cross-beam joints beneath the tram rails let repeated wheel loads start fatigue cracks that spread along the web; loose rail fastenings amplify impact, accelerating crack growth and noise. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：橫梁也把兩根主梁連成整體，提供抗扭能力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The cross beams also tie the two spines together for torsional resistance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「人行道懸臂荷載小，所以橫梁根部不需要特別檢查。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Footpath cantilevers carry little load, so cross-beam roots need no special attention." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 電車軌下方的橫梁接頭若細部設計不當或焊接缺陷，反覆輪載可能引發疲勞裂縫並沿腹板擴展；軌道支承鬆動則使衝擊放大，加速裂縫成長與噪音。
knowledge.textEn: Poor detailing or weld defects at cross-beam joints beneath the tram rails let repeated wheel loads start fatigue cracks that spread along the web; loose rail fastenings amplify impact, accelerating crack growth and noise.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雙主梁、橫梁與電車荷載的橋面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Twin spines, cross beams and tram loads" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
電腦切割的鋼板尺寸精確，焊接後的構件尺寸就一定精確。
電車軌下方的橫梁接頭若細部設計不當或焊接缺陷，反覆輪載可能引發疲勞裂縫並沿腹板擴展；軌道支承鬆動則使衝擊放大，加速裂縫成長與噪音。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Because plates are computer-cut accurately, welded parts are automatically accurate.
Poor detailing or weld defects at cross-beam joints beneath the tram rails let repeated wheel loads start fatigue cracks that spread along the web.
quiz.explanation: 電車軌下方的橫梁接頭若細部設計不當或焊接缺陷，反覆輪載可能引發疲勞裂縫並沿腹板擴展；軌道支承鬆動則使衝擊放大，加速裂縫成長與噪音。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Poor detailing or weld defects at cross-beam joints beneath the tram rails let repeated wheel loads start fatigue cracks that spread along the web; loose rail fastenings amplify impact, accelerating crack growth and noise. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
